We took two Godfather Overdrives, changed up the voicing of one, and stuffed them both into a dual pedal. The Select footswitch selects the active channel. Channel A (green LED) is The Godfather overdrive in its stock configuration. Channel B (red LED) is modified for slightly more gain and sag. The Bypass footswitch is a master bypass and will bring you back to your original tone no matter which channel is selected. The toggle switch gives you the option of running the two drives as A/B or A+B making this a possible “do all” for your overdrive needs. As with all BMF Effects pedals, The Godfather Overdrive II Dual Overdrive pedal features true bypass switching and a DC jack.
